column2: The Hashishin Rise Again

Word is spreading through the bazaars that the Hashishin, the Ormazdic order of assassins, have a new master. A scholar of the Scriptures named Al-Mualim has gathered the last of the faithful killers around him, and already a string of quiet murders in the cities of Araby can be traced back to his fearless disciples...

A new era of righteousness has begun! For years we waited in the shadows, but the order lives again under Al-Mualim, and the name of the Hashishin will soon be whispered in every palace of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] and beyond. The faithful and the meek shall find shelter under our wings, and the impious shall learn to fear our knives!
These upstart acrobats are harmless...
Glory to [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName]!
The Hashishin Take Alq

The Hashishin, the elusive order of assassins, have spread their reach into Marib. A branch of the order has raised the mountain fortress of Alq, and from its walls they watch the caravan roads below. All across Araby the Hashishin now hunt those they see as obstacles to their hidden purpose...
Word of our new fortress at Alq in Marib is spreading. The impious and the decadent begin to understand what they are dealing with. May they cower in fear!
Perhaps these Hashishin should be taken seriously...
The Hashishin Go to Ground

With the fall of their last fortress, the Hashishin have vanished from the mountains. The order is not broken, only hidden: its masters and disciples have melted into the bazaars and caravanserais of Araby, waiting for the day they can strike again.

Our last fortress has fallen and we are forced into hiding. Some will think this is the end, but they are fools. We worked from the shadows before and we will do so again. One day we shall rise, mightier than ever!
Good riddance... for now.
This setback will not be the end of the Hashishin!
The Hashishin Return

The Hashishin have returned! Their hidden disciples have rebuilt a measure of the order's strength and once more hold a fortress of their own. Their knives are again hounding those who would act against them...
Glory! The order is never broken. We suffered long in the shadows, but now we hold a fortress again, and our enemies will sleep with one eye open.
Surely they wouldn't dare strike at me.

You wake suddenly in a cold sweat, sure that something is amiss. The flickering candlelight shows a plate of warm honey cakes beside your bed, and a note pinned to the pillow by a poisoned dagger. It reads: "Mend your decadent ways before it is too late, [Root.GetFirstName]. The Hashishin are watching."
Perhaps the time for change has come...

Master, terrible news! Your faithful servant, [hashishin_victim.GetTitledName], has been found dead in [hashishin_victim.GetHerHis] chambers, no doubt at the hands of the Hashishin. Carved into [hashishin_victim.GetHerHis] chest are the words: "[Root.GetFirstName] - You were warned."
How dare they?!

As you turn a street corner in [Root.Location.GetName], a strange whistling sound swishes past your ear. Your bodyguards topple over with knives in their throats, and before you can react you are surrounded by robed Hashishin. Their leader steps up to you with a sad look on his face. "May you find what you seek in the life hereafter, friend."
But... but I am not ready!

[hashishin_victim.GetTitledName] staggers past your guards, bleeding from a dozen stab wounds. As [hashishin_victim.GetSheHe] collapses in a pool of blood at your feet, [hashishin_victim.GetSheHe] gasps with [hashishin_victim.GetHerHis] last breath: "The H-Hashishin..."
Oh my.

Your guards bring in a covered basket left just outside the palace gates. Thinking it a gift of sweets from one of your subjects, you hungrily pull away the cloth, only to find the severed, gaping head of [hashishin_victim.GetTitledName]. The mark of the Hashishin has been carved into the forehead.
I think I've lost my appetite...
A shame about [hashishin_victim.GetFirstName], but at least I have a snack!

As you stroll through your palace garden with [hashishin_victim.GetTitledFirstName], you catch the brief glint of sunlight on metal as a thrown dagger flashes past and buries itself in your companion's throat. Your bodyguards rush you to safety, but you glimpse a robed killer scrambling over the garden wall...
The Hashishin! Was I the intended target?

You wake suddenly in a cold sweat, sure that something is amiss. The flickering candlelight shows a plate of warm honey cakes beside your bed, and a note pinned to the pillow by a poisoned dagger. It reads: "There are a thousand ways to kill a [Root.GetManWoman], [Root.GetFirstName]. The Hashishin know them all."
Guards! Search the palace!
Death of a Warlord

Word spreads like wildfire across the lands of Araby! The Hashishin have killed [hashishin_target.GetTitledName], whose armies dared to sack the order's home. They came for [hashishin_target.GetHerHim] in [hashishin_target.GetHerHis] own camp, in full view of [hashishin_target.GetHerHis] guards, and though the killers outlived their mark by only a few heartbeats, their task was done.
By the Prophets!
Such fanatics!
A Warlord Foils the Hashishin

Not even the dreaded Hashishin could stop [hashishin_target.GetTitledName], whose armies sacked the order's home. Several of the order's killers died in a failed attempt on [hashishin_target.GetHerHis] life, and [hashishin_target.GetSheHe] now swears revenge on the hated assassins.
Pathetic knife-men.
